benefitSummary.en: Low-interest farm loan on a RuPay card, valid up to 5 years. Short-term loans up to Rs 3 lakh at 7% interest, effectively 4% with timely repayment. Up to Rs 2 lakh without collateral.
benefitSummary.hi: खेती के लिए सस्ता कर्ज़, रुपे कार्ड पर, 5 साल तक के लिए। 3 लाख तक का कर्ज़ 7% ब्याज पर, समय पर चुकाने पर सिर्फ़ 4%। 2 लाख तक बिना कुछ गिरवी रखे।
benefitSummary.mr: शेतीसाठी स्वस्त कर्ज, रुपे कार्डवर, 5 वर्षांपर्यंत. 3 लाखांपर्यंत कर्ज 7% व्याजाने, वेळेवर फेडल्यास फक्त 4%. 2 लाखांपर्यंत काहीही तारण न ठेवता.

notes: Eligible: owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and SHGs/JLGs of farmers.
Age limits (commonly 18-75, co-borrower needed above 60) are bank policy, not scheme rules, so they are not encoded. Mention as 'bank will confirm'.
PM-KISAN beneficiaries get a pre-filled form at their bank.
MISS crop loan limit was raised from Rs 3 lakh to Rs 5 lakh in 2025-26.
